# PM579 · R and Statistical Genomics

**Coursework and teaching-material archive**

This repository retains PM579 lab materials covering R, reproducible analysis, and statistical methods for biological data. It is a learning resource, separate from the independent research projects on this account.

## Browse the material

| Entry | Topics or contents |
| --- | --- |
| [Introduction to R](../Intro%20to%20R/) | R data structures and an R Markdown template |
| [Week 1](../week01/) | GEO data and simulation in R |
| [Week 2](../week02/) | Data formatting, dimension reduction, and filtering |
| [Week 3](../week03/) | Differential expression, RNA-seq analysis, and small-sample tests |
| [Week 4](../week04/) | q-values and multiple testing |
| [RStudio project](../PM579.Rproj) | Project entry point for the retained R/R Markdown files |
| [Original course README](../README.md) | Course context and links to earlier course iterations |

## Attribution

The original README points to [the PM579 course repository maintained by ksiegmund](https://github.com/ksiegmund/PM579). Teaching scripts, templates, and supplied datasets retain their original attribution. Their presence here is not a claim that every file was independently authored by this account's owner.

The materials and history are preserved. This repository is not presented as a new research method, an independently validated biomedical study, or a software release with a newly verified execution environment.
